remarks: Designed by Craig Schultz of Laidlaw Schultz Architects and developed by Elevate Development Advisors + RDK Coastal Properties  &  MWC, 1507 Seacrest Drive is a ground-up new construction residence set on one of the most compelling view lots in Harbor View Hills South. The approximately 3,800-square-foot, single-level home has been designed around its setting, with panoramic views across the Pacific, Catalina Island, Newport Harbor and the city lights beyond. From the entry, the architecture draws your eye through the home toward the view, while expansive walls of glass and a wide-open living environment create a direct connection to the outdoors.
